benefits.death: Depends on option: Classic pays the highest of adjusted sum assured, fund value or 105% of premiums; Classic Plus pays sum assured plus fund value.
benefits.maturity: Full fund value as a lump sum, or spread over up to 5 years (60 monthly instalments) through a settlement option.
benefits.other: Loyalty additions credited to the fund every alternate year from end of year 11 (limited/regular pay) or years 10-14 (single pay). Free-look 30 days.

ulip.loyalty_additions: Annual mode limited/regular pay: 1.8% of average fund value (PPT 5-6 yrs) or 1.2% (7+ yrs/regular); 1.6%/1.0% for other modes; single pay 1.5% for years 10-14.
ulip.premium_allocation_charge: Annual-mode limited/regular pay: year 1 is 9/6/5/4% by premium band, easing to 5/3/3/3% from year 6; single pay 3%/1.5%/1% by premium size; capped at 12.5% of annualised premium.
ulip.policy_admin_charge: Limited pay: nil for 5 years, then 0.35% a month of annualised premium rising 5% a year; single pay 0.12% a month for 5 years then 0.07%; max Rs 500 a month.
